title: Predictive maintenance ROI: what the benchmarks really show
takeaways: Unplanned downtime costs the world's 500 biggest firms $1.4 trillion a year.
88% of Indian businesses report an unplanned outage every month.
A typical Indian outage costs nearly ₹70 lakh per hour.
Measured adopters report 9% more uptime and 12% lower maintenance cost.
A false-positive rate of about 10% wiped out one program's savings.
